violations.why: Main reads v_drift twice in fn_garnet; irq_pebble can preempt in between and write it, since v_quarry is 1 after init.
irq_pebble (higher priority) can preempt irq_crest after it writes v_fjord and overwrite it before crest reads it.
irq_pebble can overwrite v_summit between crest's write and its read.
irq_pebble can change v_summit between crest's two reads, so they may see different values.
irq_pebble writes v_kiln[9000] between crest's write to it and its later read.
